verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Invasion and Hour of Devastation definitions. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
review_notes: 49 alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared substitutions; 28 structured definitions receive focused source review and one combined target build.

Split-card helper preserves cost-query order, free/token and override paths, availability versus dialog selection, saved/current mode flags, fuse legality and costs, first/second callback order, X storage, post-payment mode reads and low-bit cleanup on fizzle. Split handlers preserve cached records, mode rereads, target differences and common calls after resolution.

Keep Lightning Dart target-based sleight queries and damage/death order; Manipulate Fate filter/AI paths; Slimy Kavu targeting; Exotic Curse PT/aura routing; Blind Seer mode refresh; Archaeological Dig sacrifice, mana-color and temporary-state handling; and Defiling Tears phase-dependent cleanup.

Desert families retain repeated payment checks, availability versus payment cost/flag differences, sorcery gates, state rollback, chosen-color life loss and native info_slot=2 when the human chooses mana from the ability dialog.

Leave/Chance retains live target count and selection index before bounce, discard/draw limits and both exile/destroy calls. Samut retains cancellation cleanup and live target unmarking. Nimble Obstructionist retains stack-position checks, post-dialog stack-size rechecks, cycling cost and counter mode paths.

Scorpion God death helpers retain source/control checks, detach/status writes, counter counting after detach callbacks, pending low-byte counts and cleanup. Duplicate-legacy detection still runs the following trigger/god work.

Native inspection confirms Torment sacrifice also loses 3 life, and Hour Devastation uses separate reverse player scans with a fresh current-turn lookup between them and a planeswalker check after creature-damage callbacks. These quirks/orderings are retained.

The unused private cycling worker is also cleaned up using the matching Nimble control flow, with generic mana colors/costs and its original non-flash return. It lies outside the prior native-definition census.
No new gameplay tests, historical replay, broad native semantic harness or reccmp refresh for this readability batch.

notes: Torment: 0x020d08fb sacrifice call branches to 0x020d06d0, which loses 3 life.
Hour: 0x020d1218-0x020d1248 controls the two scans and refreshes current_turn; 0x020d12f6 returns to the post-creature planeswalker query.

status: Applied 77-definition Invasion/Hour readability batch; one combined target build follows. Reccmp deferred.
